title: Add `Parameter.spec` and deprecate `human_readable_name`
body:
This a follow up of https://github.com/pallets/click/pull/3821 , where I introduced a new `Option.get_help_spec` utility.

While discussing this change, [I realized we had 3 aspects](https://github.com/pallets/click/pull/3821#issuecomment-5510226827) of a parameter for 3 different audiences:
- `decls`: what the developer provide to its argument or option
- `spec`: what the user see in `--help` and what it provide to the CLI
- `name`: what is used internally in Click to identify that argument or option

And I just realize now that I can harmonize this vocabulary in the whole Click codebase with a small effort. This PR is that effort.

For illustration, here is the value of each property as taken from the documentation:

| | `@click.argument('recipe')` | `@click.option('-g', '--gluten-free/--no-gluten-free')` |
|---|---|---|
| `decls` | `('recipe',)` | `('-g', '--gluten-free/--no-gluten-free')` |
| `spec` | `RECIPE` | `--gluten-free` |
| `name` | `recipe` | `gluten_free` |
| `opts` | `['recipe']` | `['-g', '--gluten-free']` |
| `secondary_opts` | `[]` | `['--no-gluten-free']` |

The effects this PR has:
- Rename `Parameter.human_readable_name` to `Parameter.spec` and deprecate the former
- Make `get_help_spec` more generic by moving it from `Option` to `Parameter`
- Document `opts` and `opts `

And as such targets 8.6.0.

I still did not pushed my luck too much by proposing a rename of the `.name` property into `.id` or `.uid` as in [my original comment](https://github.com/pallets/click/pull/3821#issuecomment-5510226827) to keep this proposal reasonable. 😇
author: kdeldycke
